=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:443-445 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic tail only runs when the Semble index file is absent, so a stale pickle left behind by cleanup failure suppresses the failure log.
  WHY: If `mark_unavailable()` fails to remove the pickle, the `[ ! -f "${semble_index_path}" ]` gate becomes false and the tail of `semble_index.log` is skipped.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1260-1262 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic tail only runs when the Semble index file is absent, so a stale pickle left behind by cleanup failure suppresses the failure log.
  WHY: If `mark_unavailable()` fails to remove the pickle, the `[ ! -f "${SEMBLE_INDEX_PATH}" ]` gate becomes false and the tail of `semble_index.log` is skipped.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:621-637 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The "Install semble" step lacks `continue-on-error: true` at the step boundary.
  WHY: The script has internal fail-soft handling, but the workflow step itself can still hard-fail under shell-level errors before that logic returns.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:~450-500 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: There is no "Install semble" step present, so Semble install relies on manual uv/pip behavior instead of an explicit workflow step.
  WHY: Without the explicit step, the workflow cannot participate in the shared fail-soft Semble setup used elsewhere.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:289/920/1330 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 -c` drops invalid bytes silently.
  WHY: Malformed log content can be degraded without any signal, so Semble prefetch may miss semantic matches on garbled input.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:67-76 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `rm -rf "${index_path}" "${wrapper_path}" || true` can leave stale files on disk if cleanup fails.
  WHY: A failed delete leaves the pickle behind, and the downstream diagnostic tails that depend on its absence are skipped.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:67-76 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `rm -rf` on `wrapper_path` can recursively remove a directory if that path is unexpectedly a directory.
  WHY: With a custom wrapper path layout, a late failure in `mark_unavailable()` can delete more than the intended file.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:95-96 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `rm -rf "${index_path}" || true` may leave a stale directory at the index path.
  WHY: If a prior run created a directory there, cleanup does not reliably clear it before the next build.
- scripts/build_semble_wrapper.sh:191-193 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_default_index_path()` assumes the generated wrapper stays under a fixed parent layout.
  WHY: The fallback only works when the wrapper is in the expected location, so standalone or moved invocations can resolve the wrong index path.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:62-82 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `module_version="${...%%$'\n'*}"` assumes the version string is single-line.
  WHY: If `__version__` ever contained a newline, the slice would truncate it before comparison.
- tests/test_semble_workflow_parity_contract.py:12-44 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `TARGET_WORKFLOWS` omits `workflow-log-analysis.yml` even though this PR adds Semble integration there.
  WHY: The parity contract then skips validating that workflow's Semble wiring, so regressions there can evade pytest.
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_failure_contract.py:entire file | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The dedicated failure-contract test has no Semble assertions.
  WHY: Semble wiring regressions in `workflow-log-analysis.yml` would not be caught by this test.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
